name: Control maps (ComfyUI core: Canny, Lotus depth)

license.name: GPL-3.0 (ComfyUI core); Lotus depth weights per their own licence (see controlnet)
license.notes: a preprocessing stage: it makes the control signal another stage reads

stage.note: turns the person's raw photo or clip into the PREPARED signal a control input needs (edges or depth)

cannot.what: pose skeletons: OpenPose/DWPose need the comfyui_controlnet_aux pack (not native)

files.name: vae-ft-mse-840000-ema-pruned.safetensors
files.note: SD1.5 VAE; the Lotus depth chain uses it ('or any SD1.5 VAE')

files.name: lotus-depth-d-v1-1.safetensors
files.note: 1-step depth model used by the official depth templates (UNETLoader + LotusConditioning + SamplerCustomAdvanced/DisableNoise/SetFirstSigma + ImageInvert); needs an SD1.5 VAE

selection.why: restyle / re-render a clip keeping its layout and motion (the official Video Restyle template's depth option)
keep the clip's exact outlines (the restyle template's canny option)
a depth map for an image control input
an edge map for an image control input

pitfalls.symptom: the control video has a different frame count than the video stage's length
pitfalls.fix: set the video stage's length to the clip's frames (or trim the clip)
